questions.question: Select the most appropriate article to fill in the blank. If no article is needed, select 'No article required'.Recent studies indicate that _______ information shared by the researchers was highly valuable.

Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.A. Their problems have so far not received adequate attention in the process of development.B. Nutrition requirements of adolescents are higher than those of a normal child or adult.C. Poor nutrition can lead to deficiency and stunted growth. D. A large number of adolescent girls suffer from anaemia.E. But in India, the diet available to adolescents is inadequate in all nutrients.

Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.A. Over the years, environmental degradation has accelerated at an alarming pace.B. As a result, many governments have begun to prioritise sustainable development.C. Industrialisation and urban expansion have contributed significantly to this problem.D. However, the challenge lies in balancing economic growth with environmental protection.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (A → C → B → D) है।

Comprehension:Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.Disability is a part of being humans. Almost everyone will temporarily or permanently experience disability at some point in their life. An estimated 1.3 billion people, about 16% of the global population, currently experience significant disability. This number is increasing due in part to population ageing and an increase in the prevalence of noncommunicable diseases. Disability results from the interaction of individuals having a health condition, such as cerebral palsy, Down syndrome and depression, with personal and environmental factors, including negative attitudes, inaccessible transportation, public buildings and limited social support. A person’s environment has a huge effect on the experience and extent of disability. Inaccessible environments create barriers that often hinder the full and effective participation of persons with disabilities in society on an equal basis with others. Progress on improving social participation can be made by addressing these barriers and facilitating persons with disabilities in their day to day lives.Q76. According to the passage, what is one major way to improve social participation for persons with disabilities?
options: Reducing the prevalence of cerebral palsy
Decreasing the number of health conditions
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Addressing barriers and facilitating accessibility) है।
